title: Run Assessment
description: Compact machine-readable terminal assessment created AFTER an Operator run (or after a mission is rejected before execution). Contains facts useful to future mission selection and dedup. Facts only: every field is either directly derivable from the canonical run record or omitted. The mission_rejected branch represents a pre-execution framing rejection: it carries a rejection_reason_code and MUST NOT fabricate normal execution facts (review_verdict/gate/target/run-record/handoffs). No free-form confidence/self-scoring fields (no system_confidence, no LLM scores) — by design.

run_id.description: Canonical run id. Absent/null for the pre-execution mission_rejected branch (no run was initialized).

terminal_outcome.description: mission_rejected is the terminal outcome of a framing rejection before normal execution (POL-10); the other values are executed-run outcomes.

rejection_reason_code.description: Machine-readable reason for terminal_outcome: mission_rejected (invalid_framing, unsafe_scope, duplicate_mission, unsupported, evidence_inadequate, other).

rejection_reason.description: Optional evidence-backed explanation for the rejection.

diagnosis.description: Short evidence-backed diagnosis / defect disposition text.

ledger_disposition.description: Ledger disposition resulting from this run.
